title: Titan Endurance
description: 15-minute EMOM plus a 12-minute AMRAP to push your endurance limits without let-up

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Fast lateral steps, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate arched and rounded back, breathe

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width apart, lower thighs parallel to the floor

exercises.name: Incline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands on an elevated support, easier variation

exercises.name: Burpees without push-up
exercises.instructions: Drop down, jump feet back, return, jump up

exercises.name: Alternating lunges
exercises.instructions: Alternate forward left and forward right without pausing

exercises.name: Wide push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands wider than shoulders, focus on the chest

exercises.name: Leg raises
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift the straight legs to vertical

exercises.name: Jump squats
exercises.instructions: Explosive squat with a jump, cushion the landing

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Hip flexor stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
